_what: What happens to a listening's heard rows after they are written, and what an ask about a listening waits for (read-data/what-was-said.mjs). `rename`: the speaker label an unknown voice is written under (a regular expression) and how many rows one write carries. `keep_sound`: the compressed file a piece's sound is kept as, made by the ffmpeg the person granted (`encode`, {input} and {output} filled). `write_back`: the name of the speakers file written beside a recording. `captions`: the ops a caption change can be, and how many captions an answer gives (`last`, at most `most`). `transcriber`: how long one device holds the role without hearing another piece. `ask`: how long an ask waits for what was said before it to be written, at most, and how often it looks.

words.rename_needs: Say which listening (`listening`), which voices it heard (`voices`, the enrol tool's heard_as) and the person's name (`name`).
words.sound_not_kept: The sound was not kept: {why}. The words were written.
words.needs_listening: Say which listening: `listening` is its name.
words.caption_needs_id: The caption op {op} needs `id`: the heard row it changes.
words.caption_unknown_op: {op} is not a caption op. Ops: {ops}.
words.ask_needs: Say which listening (`listening`) and which conversation asks (`conversation`), so it is given only what it has not been given.
